item.title: Business Interruption Insurance for Solar Installers (AU Guide)
item.description: Most solar install businesses don’t go under because of one bad job. They go under because something stops the job queue for six weeks while the wages, the ute repayments and the software subscriptions keep coming out every fortnight. A storm takes out the shed and the stock in it, your lead installer does a knee coming off a ladder, or a container of inverters sits on a wharf. The work is still there, but you can’t do it, so nothing gets invoiced.

item.title: Job Costing for Solar Installers: Quoted vs Real Margin
item.description: Here is the uncomfortable truth about job costing on solar installs: the margin you quote and the margin you keep are two different numbers, and most installers never sit down to work out the gap. The quote is a forecast. The real margin only shows up weeks later, once the panels are on, the sparky is paid, the certificates are sold and the callbacks are done. By then you have already moved on to the next job, and the leak never gets found.
